svg.aria-label: The evals: one cook run, in memory
svg.title: The evals: one cook run, in memory

g.text: a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: an eval's folder becomes trials, and each trial's checks grade it into events. The folder is
demos/puls/evals/louis-agent.identity.puls.evals/Evals/Cook, and its nine checks are cook-no-error, routed-to,
within-budget, estimates-at-shop, untooled-shops, recipe-image, serves-as-asked, meal-for-people and meal-for-people.human.
